L0·N365unmasked layer
Positional neuron on the second word of a two-word noun phrase: it fires when that word is a capitalized continuation of a proper name/title (e.g. "Rural **Utilities**", "American **Girl**") or a determiner like " the" after a capitalized verb, and is strongly suppressed when the following word is a lowercase generic noun ("Product **description**", "Song **lyrics**", "Source **file**").
